purpose: Offline navigation and observation-gap audit of the completed 45-trial final_matrix; does not modify source results.

startup.note: Same simulation; search restarted with final frame/cancellation fixes, client now uses volatile results and explicit previous-ID exclusion. Starts in kitchen after retained-result batch abort; no teleportation/reset between cases.

loaded_version_boundary.interpretation: Preserved run-time artifact declarations for the restarted final search/client. These are not replaced by hashes of later workspace edits or the proposed bounded-wait fix.

interpretation: Navigation succeeded twice with no recovery within this trial; the robot was stationary during the first configured observation interval.
Zero synchronized_messages means no synchronized callback passing the arrival/duplicate timestamp gate was counted. It does not establish that each raw input topic was silent.
No message was counted as rejected for dimensions/intrinsics/encoding, and no target TF/depth failure was recorded at that view.

The detector log is empty and search logs contain only task start/result; separate RGB, depth, CameraInfo and detection receipt rates, timestamp skew, inference duration and callback-queue latency were not recorded.
Available evidence cannot distinguish detector interruption, synchronization/transport gaps, stale timestamps, or scheduling/backlog. No CPU root cause is established.
partial_observation_trial_44.proposed_bounded_wait_scope: A later bounded observation-wait change is a mitigation candidate and must retain this failed batch unchanged; it cannot retroactively establish the root cause.

method: Each navigation log event is assigned only if its wall timestamp lies between that trial command_sent_unix_seconds and started_utc + elapsed_client_wall_seconds. Trial windows were asserted nonoverlapping. Earlier batches and between-trial log events are excluded.
Each navigation leg runs from BT Begin navigating to matching Goal succeeded/failed; restart/clear attempts inside that leg remain part of its measured duration.
Task wall time comes from search elapsed_wall_seconds. Navigation legs are separated from the residual observation-and-orchestration time; that residual is not claimed to be pure dwell time.

First-leg time includes return travel or entry from another room, depending on the actual starting position. The first living cup-count trial starts at its first view; later repeats return from the second view.
Progress failures, local/global clears and explicit spin/backup/wait starts are separate event categories. Error/warning lines are message counts, not independent collision or recovery episodes.
The trace uses measured map TF/odometry without simulator truth. Its sim-time range begins late in the matrix, so it does not support retrospective trajectory analysis of early living trials.
Navigation/search/detector logs are captured as observed prefixes because later experiments may append to the same files.
limitations: This batch is 44 passed trials plus one honest partial result, not 45/45 success. All 75 navigation goals succeeded; navigation success does not imply complete observation data.
Warm repetitions after a search restart do not establish repeated full-stack cold-start or independent entry reliability.
No planner/controller, weights, map boundary, ground-truth sensing, full-room coverage or G0 claim is changed by this review.
No per-input timing/CPU telemetry exists for trial 44; its missing qualified synchronized observations have an undetermined root cause.
Later bounded-wait experiments must be reported separately from this preserved version and result set.
